evidence.notes: Approval process execution requires org approval-process metadata and returns a stable UnsupportedFeature diagnostic locally.
Business-hours datetime math supports local BusinessHours records and returns a stable UnsupportedFeature diagnostic for missing record IDs.
Business-hours GMT datetime math requires BusinessHours and holiday metadata; the local runtime does not assume a 24x7 calendar.
Business-hours reopening calculation requires BusinessHours and holiday metadata; the local runtime returns a stable UnsupportedFeature diagnostic.
